entries.en: WHO'RE YOU? THIS IS NO PLACE[n]FOR RUNTS LIKE YOURSELVES.
Oh, sorry.
Well that's not nice.
I'm no runt.
UGH, BRATS THESE DAYS THINK[n]APOLOGIZING CAN GET THEM OUT[n]OF ANYTHING.
WHO ARE YOU, ANYWAY? YOU DON'T[n]SEEM LIKE EMPLOYEES.
DON'T PREACH TO ME. YOU'RE[n]THE ONES TRESPASSING HERE.
SUCH RUDENESS REALLY PISSES ME OFF![n]I'LL DISASSEMBLE YOU AND USE YOUR[n]BODIES FOR FUEL!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: All we can do is fight now! Let's do our[n]best, Joker!
BWAHAHA! IF YOU'RE NOT A RUNT,[n]YOU'RE DEFINITELY A BRAT!
[clr 2]YOUNGLINGS THESE DAYS[clr 27] ARE SUCH[n]SLACKERS! WE WERE MUCH MORE[n]DECENT [clr 2]WHEN WE WERE YOUNG[clr 27]!
SO... WHO'RE YOU?
We're the Phantom Thieves.
We're janitors.
We're salesmen.
THE PHANTOM THIEVES, YOU SAY?[n]YOU'VE GOT SOME NERVE.
DO YOU THINK I'D FORGIVE YOU IF[n]YOU JUST TOLD ME? I'LL DISPOSE OF[n]YOU RIGHT HERE!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Looks like we're out of options... Let's do[n]this, everyone!
JANITORS!? O-OH... WELL, GOOD WORK.
I DON'T HAVE TIME TO MEMORIZE[n]JANITOR'S FACES IF OUR COMPANY[n]WILL BE THE [clr 2]BEST OF THE BEST[clr 27].
...SO, WHAT BUSINESS DO YOU[n]JANITORS HAVE WITH ME?
YOU WANT TO SELL THINGS IN CLOTHES[n]LIKE THAT? TALK ABOUT NO COMMON[n]SENSE.
WE TOOK OUR JOBS SERIOUSLY[n][clr 2]WHEN WE WERE YOUNG[clr 27]...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It is time we make our decision, Joker.[n]What do you want to do?
Let's fight him.
We should leave.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Right, there's no need for any more[n]discussion. Take him down!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you don't want to fight right now?[n]Then let's retreat!
H-HEY, GET BACK HERE! YOU CAN'T[n]LEAVE WITHOUT MY PERMISSION!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Serves you right, bastard! That takes[n]care of that!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This guy's got nothing on him though.[n]1000% waste of time.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I-It seems their physical size doesn't[n]necessarily correlate to their rank...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The chief director must be somewhere[n]else... Let's try looking in another room.
